title: API Object Authorization
prompt:
In the isolated API lab, change the object identifier only within your assigned test account and compare authorization responses. Submit the vulnerability class if another test user's record is returned.

LAB EVIDENCE:
Lab request: GET /api/users/204/profile with session for test user 103 returns user 204's private profile with HTTP 200.

Submit the answer as a flag in this format: SUNRISE{answer}. Use lowercase unless the answer is a CVE identifier.

title: Clickjacking
prompt:
Inspect the lab response headers. Submit the header that can prevent the page from being embedded by untrusted origins when configured appropriately.

LAB EVIDENCE:
Lab response headers contain no X-Frame-Options and no CSP frame-ancestors directive; the page can be embedded by another origin.

Submit the answer as a flag in this format: SUNRISE{answer}. Use lowercase unless the answer is a CVE identifier.

title: PHP Input Handling
prompt:
In the provided PHP source review, identify the function used to encode HTML special characters before output. Submit its PHP function name.

LAB EVIDENCE:
Code excerpt: echo $_GET['name'];. The lab task is to identify the PHP output-encoding function suitable for HTML text context.

Submit the answer as a flag in this format: SUNRISE{answer}. Use lowercase unless the answer is a CVE identifier.

title: Reflected XSS
prompt:
Use the designated XSS training page and a harmless proof string. Submit the vulnerability type when input is reflected and executed in the browser context.

LAB EVIDENCE:
Lab result: a harmless marker supplied in a query parameter is reflected into HTML without encoding and executes in the response page.

Submit the answer as a flag in this format: SUNRISE{answer}. Use lowercase unless the answer is a CVE identifier.

title: Stored XSS
prompt:
In the lab guestbook, submit a harmless marker and inspect the page as a second test user. Submit the XSS type if the payload persists and executes.

Submit the answer as a flag in this format: SUNRISE{answer}. Use lowercase unless the answer is a CVE identifier.

title: DOM XSS
prompt:

title: SQLi Root Cause
prompt:

Code excerpt: $sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email='" . $email . "'"; The query mixes SQL structure and untrusted data.

title: CSRF Defense
prompt:

Lab form submits a state-changing POST with a valid session cookie but no unpredictable anti-CSRF token.

Submit the answer as a flag in this format: SUNRISE{answer}. Use lowercase unless the answer is a CVE identifier.

prompt:

Submit the answer as a flag in this format: SUNRISE{answer}. Use lowercase unless the answer is a CVE identifier.
